incidents.name: UwU Lend sUSDE oracle manipulation
incidents.notes: UwU Lend's Aave-fork LendingPool priced sUSDE from an oracle reading Curve pool spot state, so a flash-loan sequence that skewed those pools inflated sUSDE collateral value and let the attacker borrow out most of the protocol's other markets.

sources.ref: onchain review: LendingPool proxy 0x2409aF0251DCB89EE3Dee572629291f9B087c668 (verified as InitializableImmutableAdminUpgradeabilityProxy) created 2022-09-19T16:55:47Z by 0x50831130c4b0aa78fca9edaa39d7339a9620d751, not the attack-tx sender 0x841ddf093f5188989fa1524e7b893de64b421f47. It emits no EIP-1967 Upgraded events, so the EIP-1967 implementation slot was read directly: 0x05bfa9157e92690b179033ca2f6dd1e86b25ea4d at the creation block, the pre-incident block 20061318 and today alike, confirming the implementation never changed and age runs from deployment (629.8 days). A second exploit on the same pool three days later (tx 0x9235e0662e230bdfa94f56f4932fd09a95fea17e4b9b44a4f40a59449e216110, ~$3.7M, src/test/2024-06/UwuLend_Second_exp.sol) is the same victim contract and root cause and is not recorded as a separate row.

deployment-basis recheck extended to the whole delegate set: callTracer shows the LendingPool proxy delegatecalling 0x05bfa9157e92690b179033ca2f6dd1e86b25ea4d (the EIP-1967 implementation) plus the Aave-style linked libraries 0x3c0ada81038a078cc1272ac22745ddd1ab8839af and 0xaede01960810a655aecf86278bfdf5c968198b89, which are link-time constants inside that implementation and cannot be repointed. The implementation slot returns 0x05bfa915... at the creation block 15568883, at the incident block 20061319 and at all 201 evenly spaced samples in between, and the proxy runtime is byte-identical at both blocks. Deployment is the correct basis; 629.8 days.
